answer: Receipts are issued in harbor, burned on slash in haven, and listed in grove. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 32 epochs. That removes the yield anyone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Each duplicate costs another 58 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
